late_fee.applies_to: open invoices not paid by their due date
late_fee.rule: No fee while an invoice is at most grace_days past its due date. After that, the fee is daily_rate times the invoice amount for each day past the end of the grace period, capped at max_fee_eur per invoice.

vat.note: Band zero is zero-rated: no VAT is charged, but its net amounts still belong in the VAT return.
